 The Police Sub-Inspector of C.K.Achukattu P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323, 504 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Ramya.S..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married to CW-1 on 11-12-2022.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with Accused No.1 and 2 at Chitradurga.

Later when CW-1 came to Bangalore and stayed with Accused No.1 at BSK 3rd stage,
Lakshmanappa garden 8th main house NO.135/2 1st floor at that time, the Accused No.1 teased about her caste and demanded more money in order to earn at Dubai.
The Accused No.1 took CW-1 to Dubai, there also Accused No.1 continued cruelty abusing her.
The Accused No.2 also abused with filthy words to CW-1 over phone.
3  C.C.No.1655/2024 The Accused No.2 took away all jewels of CW-1 under the pretext of keeping in bank and flew away to Dubai with CW-1.

On 26-6-2023 the Accused No.1 and 2 with common intention tried to confine CW-1 in a room, abused and pushed her causing bleeding injury to CW-1 and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry.
Based on the information of Smt. Ramya.S., a case in Cr.No.228/2023 came to be registered against the accused No.1 and 2 for the aforesaid offences.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 and 2 entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 and 2 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and 2 and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to  4  C.C.No.1655/2024 the accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them, to which,
the accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 and 2 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused No.1 and 2 , the recording of Statement of Accused No.1 and 2 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-

sentences.text:
My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........ As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.1655/2024  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex. P1
is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1.

She in her examination-in- chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 11-12-2022 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never assaulted and abused her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1
first information

sentences.text: PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and  6  C.C.No.1655/2024 she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 7  C.C.No.1655/2024  ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 323,504 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
